name: Bank of Shanghai Co., Ltd.
note: Listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE 601229). Per its 2025 annual report (published 24 April 2026): no controlling shareholder and no actual controller; largest shareholder Shanghai Alliance Investment Co., Ltd. with 2,092,800,328 shares (14.73%), marked 'state-owned legal person' (国有法人), 14.98% with affiliates and concert parties, plus two nominated directors; Shanghai International Port (Group) Co., Ltd., whose actual controller is also Shanghai SASAC, held 8.54%. The state stake is confirmed unchanged at 30 June 2026 in the bank's 2026 half-year report.
